instruction: I'm working on a Tetris game in Python. The space bar instant drop feature (go_space method in tetris.py) has a logic issue - it moves the block down until collision, then moves back up one step, and freezes. Please verify the logic is correct and ensure it properly drops the block to the lowest valid position before freezing.
